_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — 'Civic Education (Forms 1-4) Syllabus - Scope, Content, Sequence & Curriculum Analysis Grids', Form 4 rows (items 61-74 of the document's Scope and Sequence Overview table, identified by the table's column-position markers for the Form 4 colour key). The source document is authored/compiled by a named individual, whose name, title and contact details have been removed — this file contains no identifying information, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. As with civic_education_form1.json, this scope-and-sequence table gives only a Topic, Sub-Topic/Unit and a brief 'Key Content Focus' phrase per row (no numbered CDC 'Specific Competence' outcome codes) — competency statements below are a direct paraphrase of each row's Key Content Focus into standard competency-statement form, not verbatim official CDC outcome text. The source document also contains a more detailed 'Curriculum Analysis Grid' section per form (learning strategies, assessment, materials) not used for this ingestion pass. No week-level pacing was available (only term). This is the last form in the document's scope-and-sequence table (item 74 of 74).

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Ordinary Level Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 4
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 4" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 4.1.1 Concept of Legal System
sub_topics.description: Elements of a good legal system; sources of law (common, customary); elements of a crime; classification of crime; criminal vs civil cases.

competencies.description: Explain the elements and sources of a legal system, and distinguish criminal from civil cases

sub_topics.name: 4.1.2 Zambian Legal System - Trial Stages
sub_topics.description: Pre-trial, trial, post-trial stages; criminal justice procedure (arrest, plea, trial); types of sentences.

competencies.description: Describe the stages of a criminal trial in Zambia's legal system, from arrest to sentencing

sub_topics.name: 4.2.1 International Bill of Rights
sub_topics.description: UDHR, ICCPR, ICESCR; human rights institutions.

competencies.description: Identify the instruments of the International Bill of Rights (UDHR, ICCPR, ICESCR) and human rights institutions

sub_topics.name: 4.3.1 Causes, Effects & Alleviation
sub_topics.description: Causes (unemployment, low education); effects; poverty alleviation strategies.

competencies.description: Explain the causes and effects of poverty in Zambia and strategies for its alleviation

sub_topics.name: 4.4.1 Gender Equity & Equality
sub_topics.description: Sex vs gender roles; efforts to reduce gender gap (Ministry of Gender, GIDD, CEDAW, Beijing Conference); institutions promoting gender equity (Parliament, Police, ACC, NGOs like CAMFED).

competencies.description: Distinguish sex from gender roles and identify efforts and institutions promoting gender equity and equality

sub_topics.name: 4.4.2 Gender Based Violence (GBV)
sub_topics.description: Forms (physical, psychological, emotional); causes (jealousy, infidelity); effects (depression, death); reporting cases; empathy.

competencies.description: Identify forms and causes of gender-based violence and explain how to report cases with empathy

sub_topics.name: 4.5.1 Development Planning
sub_topics.description: Levels (individual, family, community); types (short, medium, long term); methods (centralised/decentralised); importance of national budgeting and fiscal discipline.

competencies.description: Explain the levels, types and methods of development planning, and the importance of national budgeting and fiscal discipline

sub_topics.name: 4.5.2 Micro & Macro Economic Financial Institutions
sub_topics.description: Functions: micro (personal loans, savings, rural credit); macro (central bank, commercial banks).

competencies.description: Distinguish the functions of micro (personal loans, savings, rural credit) and macro (central bank, commercial banks) financial institutions

sub_topics.name: 4.5.3 Indicators of Development
sub_topics.description: GDP, literacy rate, life expectancy, HDI, etc.

competencies.description: Identify indicators of development (GDP, literacy rate, life expectancy, Human Development Index)

sub_topics.name: 4.5.4 Zambia's National Development Plans
sub_topics.description: Evaluation from independence to date (FNDP, SNDP, 7NDP, 8NDP).

competencies.description: Evaluate Zambia's national development plans from independence to date (FNDP, SNDP, 7NDP, 8NDP)
Explain the function of the Credit Reference Bureau and the importance of a good credit history

sub_topics.name: 4.7.1 Securities and Exchange Commission of Zambia

competencies.description: Explain the functions of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zambia in regulating capital markets
Explain personal and business risk management strategies (insurance, emergency funds, diversification)

sub_topics.name: 4.9.1 Retirement Planning
sub_topics.description: Plan for retirement; investment for old age.

competencies.description: Explain how to plan and invest for retirement
